customSize.q: Can I set my own box size?
customSize.a: Yes. Enter the inside length × width × height in the configurator and the price for that size is worked out straight away.

fit.q: How do I find the box size that fits?
fit.a: Enter your product's outside size in "Find a box size". We add 0.5 cm to each dimension and suggest the smallest standard size that fits.
